Study ID: TL-802-P3
Sponsor: Aura Clinical Research Institute
Date: January 2026

metadata.document_name: TL-802 Phase 3 Clinical Study Report
metadata.section: Phase 3 Clinical Study Report: Investigational Oncology Compound TL-802

doc_cd3412f004_c1.text: This randomized, double-blind, multicenter Phase 3 trial evaluated TL-802 compared to standard-of-care in 480 adult patients with advanced refractory non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). Patients were randomized 1:1 to receive either TL-802 (150 mg orally once daily) or comparator chemotherapy.

metadata.document_name: TL-802 Phase 3 Clinical Study Report

doc_cd3412f004_c2.text: The primary endpoint was Progression-Free Survival (PFS) by blinded independent central review. Median PFS in the TL-802 arm was 14.8 months (95% CI: 12.6–16.9) compared to 7.2 months (95% CI: 5.9–8.4) in the comparator arm (Hazard Ratio = 0.52; p < 0.0001). Overall Response Rate (ORR) was 58.3% for TL-802 versus 27.5% for comparator.

metadata.document_name: TL-802 Phase 3 Clinical Study Report

doc_cd3412f004_c3.text:
- Nausea: reported in 14.2% of patients (Grade 3/4: 1.8%)
- Fatigue: reported in 11.5% of patients (Grade 3/4: 1.2%)
- Headache: reported in 9.8% of patients (Grade 3/4: 0.8%)
- Diarrhea: reported in 7.4% of patients (Grade 3/4: 0.5%)
- Elevated ALT/AST: reported in 6.1% of patients (Grade 3/4: 2.1%)
Serious adverse events (SAEs) occurred in 4.2% of TL-802 patients versus 6.8% in the comparator arm. Discontinuation due to adverse events was 2.9% for TL-802.

doc_cd3412f004_c4.text: TL-802 is contraindicated in patients with severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh Class C) or known hypersensitivity to the active substance. Monitoring of liver enzymes is recommended every 2 weeks during the first 2 months of treatment.
